instruction.name: x86mttop
instruction.description: Set the x87 TOP pointer to imm.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'x86mttop 0' --asm 'x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1; x86mttop 1'
throughput.notes: Eight copies take 2.00 cycles, sixteen 4.00 and thirty-two 8.01, so the top-of-stack pointer update does not serialise: the instruction sustains 4 IPC (0.25 CPI) on LA464, against 1 IPC on LA664. The body must stay inside L1I: the same eight instructions at unroll 4000 are a 128 KiB body and read 7.18 cycles instead of 2.00.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
